name: 🔪 Keys and Knives [SQUID GAME 3]
desc:
🔪 Welcome to The Keys and Knives [SQUID GAME  3]

When the gumball drops, you're either a Hunter or a Runner.

Knife (Hunter):
- Eliminate all key players before they escape.
- Work with other hunters.

Key (Runner):
- Find the correct door using your key.
- Avoid knife players at all costs.

Tags: Squid Game, Knives Vs Keys, Squid Game Season 3, Gumball Game, Knives and Keys, Red Light Green Light, Jump Rope
